title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2000

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2000.

2. The following companies are hereby granted exemption from tax on the income received in Singapore by the companies from countries outside Singapore, subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letters of approval addressed to the respective companies:
Company
Date of Letter of Approval
(a) Antara Koh Private Limited
3rd April 2000
(b) NatSteel Broadway Ltd
5th April 2000.
